description.value: Little Caesars Pizza is a franchise location of the international fast-food pizza chain situated on Beverly Street in Duncan, in the Cowichan Valley. The chain is known for its carryout-focused model with ready-to-go pizzas available for quick pickup. For a touring cyclist needing a fast, filling meal in Duncan, it offers a familiar and reliable stop.

No amenity evidence (bike parking, washrooms, Wi-Fi, water refill) exists in either source for this specific location.
